businessModel: Free; funds Bing/Microsoft services, Microsoft 365 and Copilot upsell, shopping/rewards features
paidNote: Browse with Copilot (agentic) limited to Microsoft 365 Premium subscribers in the US

summary: A feature-rich Chromium browser preinstalled on Windows: strong tab tools, Copilot folded into the core UI since May 2026, and Android extensions, but heavy Microsoft services, telemetry and MV2 removal ending by end of 2026.

pros.title: Excellent tab tools
pros.detail: Native vertical tabs, split screen, tab groups, sleeping tabs and Efficiency mode.

pros.title: Copilot integrated
pros.detail: Copilot Mode was folded into core Edge in May 2026 with multi-tab reasoning, Journeys, voice and vision.

pros.title: Chrome compatibility
pros.detail: Same Blink engine and Chrome Web Store support, with Edge Add-ons as a second source.

pros.title: Android extensions
pros.detail: Edge for Android can install extensions from Edge Add-ons, something Chrome for Android still cannot do.

pros.title: Enterprise-ready
pros.detail: IE mode, Edge for Business, thousands of policies and Defender SmartScreen integration.

pros.title: Free Secure Network VPN
pros.detail: Cloudflare-powered VPN with a free monthly allowance when signed in (cap not re-verified).

cons.title: MV2 ending
cons.detail: Microsoft is disabling Manifest V2 extensions for consumers through the end of 2026, ending full uBlock Origin (enterprise early 2027).

cons.title: Microsoft promotions
cons.detail: Bing, Copilot, shopping and rewards prompts are on by default and frequently criticized.

cons.title: Telemetry
cons.detail: Collects diagnostic and usage data, with signed-in Microsoft personalisation.

cons.title: Features come and go
cons.detail: Collections retired in v146, Workspaces sharing retired, sidebar changes in v150.

signatureFeatures: Copilot in Edge (Journeys, Browse with Copilot)

faq.q: Is Edge ending support for uBlock Origin?
faq.a: Yes for consumers: Microsoft began disabling MV2 extensions in Canary/Dev/Beta in August 2026 and plans to finish the consumer rollout by end of 2026, with enterprise in early 2027. uBlock Origin Lite (MV3) remains.
Microsoft retired it on May 13, 2026 and built its multi-tab reasoning, Journeys, voice, vision and writing features directly into Edge on desktop and mobile.

faq.q: Does Edge for Android support extensions?
faq.a: Yes. Edge for Android can install extensions from the Edge Add-ons catalog; iOS has none.
